description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.035 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Pure-math portfolio rebalancing calculator. Given current holdings (asset names and their current USD values) and target allocations (percentages summing to 100), returns the exact buy/sell dollar amounts needed to reach target weights. Handles partial rebalancing with a drift threshold. No external API — deterministic and instant. Useful for DeFi agents, robo-advisory flows, and automated rebalancing triggers.
